title: Carry a rejected job's request and findings into a retry reading
summary: When `athena ask` receives "try again on <job>", Athena resolves the job id, checks that the job was rejected, and passes that job's request text and verifier findings to the reader as a new "Earlier attempt" section in the reader brief. The new job's own request stays as typed.

defaults_applied.how: One focused change: a detected phrase plus one new brief section, with no new command.
Unit and lifecycle tests are added, and cargo test and clippy must pass.
The exact trigger form was left unsaid. It is inferred from the quoted phrase and the existing free-text `ask` interface.
All changes are Rust, plus Markdown docs.
Doc comments and the changelog entry are written for an outside reader.
Carried text is redacted before it reaches the reader and the records.

assumptions: The trigger is the phrase 'try again on <job>' (case-insensitive) at the start of the text given to `athena ask` (and `ask --later` when it is read). No new subcommand is added.
<job> is resolved with the existing Records::resolve, so full ids and unique prefixes work.
Only a job closed as rejected qualifies. Any other state, or an unknown id, is an error with a clear message and no reader call.

The prior job's request text and its verification findings (severity, text) are included. The new job is a fresh job whose request is the user's text as typed. Diffs and producer output are not carried.
The carried text is redacted with the existing redactor and quoted in the brief as data, like the request.

acceptance_criteria.text: ReaderInputs in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gains an optional field for an earlier rejected attempt (job id, request text, findings). reader_brief renders it as its own quoted section only when present, and output without it is unchanged.

A function in athena-core detects 'try again on <job>', resolves the job, and builds the attempt from that job's request record and its final verification findings. It refuses a job that is not rejected, or that has no request or verification, with an error naming the job and its state.
read_for / ask / first_reading pass the attempt through to reader_brief. The carried request and findings text goes through the redactor.
README.md and CHANGELOG.md mention the 'try again on <job>' form.
Run `cargo test`: a unit test in briefs.rs shows the brief contains the earlier request and findings when set and does not contain the section when unset.

Run `cargo test`: a lifecycle test using the fake driver rejects a job, then runs ask 'try again on <id>' and shows the reader's brief includes that job's request and findings. A second test shows a landed or unknown job is refused.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.

out_of_scope: Retrying blocked, failed, or closed-by-user jobs.
Carrying the producer's diff, brief, or transcript to the reader.
Changing how the producer or verifier briefs are built.
Changes to records schemas or governance files.
departures: The reference cost p50 looks low for a change that touches core, context, the CLI and a lifecycle test, so I raised it. I lowered p_reading_accepted because the request does not say whether the trigger is an `ask` phrase or a new subcommand.
